faces.name: Glyph Elemental
faces.oracleText:
Bestow {1}{W} (If you cast this card for its bestow cost, it's an Aura spell with enchant creature. It becomes a creature again if it's not attached.)
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this permanent.
Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 for each +1/+1 counter on this Aura.

faces.name: Glyph Keeper
faces.oracleText:
Flying
Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability for the first time each turn, counter that spell or ability.
Embalm {5}{U}{U} ({5}{U}{U}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Create a token that's a copy of it, except it's a white Zombie Sphinx with no mana cost. Embalm only as a sorcery.)

faces.name: Glyph of Delusion
faces.oracleText: Put X glyph counters on target creature that target Wall blocked this turn, where X is the power of that blocked creature. The creature gains "This creature doesn't untap during your untap step if it has a glyph counter on it" and "At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a glyph counter from this creature."

faces.name: Glyph of Destruction
faces.oracleText: Target blocking Wall you control gets +10/+0 until end of combat. Prevent all damage that would be dealt to it this turn. Destroy it at the beginning of the next end step.

faces.name: Glyph of Doom
faces.oracleText: Choose target Wall creature. At this turn's next end of combat, destroy all creatures that were blocked by that creature this turn.

faces.name: Glyph of Life
faces.oracleText: Choose target Wall creature. Whenever that creature is dealt damage by an attacking creature this turn, you gain that much life.

faces.name: Glyph of Reincarnation
faces.oracleText:
Cast this spell only after combat.
Destroy all creatures that were blocked by target Wall this turn. They can't be regenerated. For each creature that died this way, put a creature card from the graveyard of the player who controlled that creature the last time it became blocked by that Wall onto the battlefield under its owner's control.
